title: Carlos Made the Alhambra Come Alive
text:
Our guided tour of the Alhambra was absolutely outstanding, largely thanks to our brilliant guide, Carlos. His knowledge was incredible, he seemed to know every detail about every corner, room and section of the palace and its grounds.

Carlos brought the history of the Alhambra to life through fascinating stories and detailed explanations. His knowledge extended far beyond the palace itself, giving us a much deeper understanding of Granada and its rich history.

If you are considering booking this tour, do not hesitate. Ask for Carlos if possible, you will leave with an in-depth understanding
author: Fearless38039611273

title: A place out of time, magical and magnificent!
text:
A must-visit place if you are passing through the Granada region. Paid parking at a price that is not exorbitant (€11.50 for 4 hours).
If you wish to eat when leaving the site, the Carmen restaurant is a good recommendation. The daily menu is priced at €16.50, it is located right in front of the site exit, on the other side of the road, the entrance is a bit hidden, you can access it through the souvenir shop entrance (stairs).
Small tip: visit the site as soon as it opens because there are fewer people and above all it is less hot!

title: Very LONG day full of...
text: Very LONG day full of walking and lots of stairs and uneven walkways. Amazing areas to see and so much to learn about Andalucian culture and history. Our 9 & 11 year old granddaughters enjoyed seeing it- unfortunately we visited on one of the hottest days (100’F). Take plenty of water, sunscreen, a hat, and wear good tennies or walking shoes. Areas to buys snacks, water, and souvenirs. We had been before about 16 years ago- much easier when we were younger😉.
